about: Everything from other people that SungFluence ships, with its license and where it goes. NOTICE.md is the readable version. tests/notices.test.js checks this list against src/vendor, src/fonts, app/plugins, scripts/vendor.js and package.json. Ships: desktop = the installed app (Windows, macOS, Linux), web = the web app at /try, website = the GitHub Pages site, installer-windows = only inside the Windows Setup and Portable files, installer-linux = only inside the Linux AppImage file, repository = the source code. A file in src/vendor or src/fonts must be copied by scripts/vendor.js from the package named in its entry; an entry that is added by hand on purpose says why in "addedByHand".
